summary: Find books at Anna Centenary Library in Chennai. Search its catalog by title or author, or look up an exact ISBN, then check the returned edition and available copy information.
access: Check membership and borrowing rules with the library before visiting.

summary: Find books at Kalaignar Centenary Library in Madurai. Search its catalog by title or author, or look up an exact ISBN, then check the returned edition, copies and shelf location.
access: Check membership and borrowing rules with the library before visiting. The catalog marks some copies, such as gratis copies, as not for loan.

summary: Search Ernakulam Public Library’s catalog in Kochi by title or author, then check the returned edition and copy information. Many titles are catalogued in English letters.
access: Ernakulam Public Library is a membership library. Confirm membership and borrowing rules directly with the library.

summary: Explore Visakhapatnam Public Library’s catalog by title or author. This connection uses catalog records rather than ISBN lookup.
access: Membership and borrowing rules apply. Confirm eligibility directly with the library.

summary: Check an ISBN against Aliah University Library’s Koha catalog in Kolkata. Catalog results can include copy counts, locations and call numbers.
access: This is a university library. Borrowing requires library membership; public access must be confirmed with the institution.

summary: Look up books by ISBN in the Central Library, IIT Bhubaneswar catalog. Check the returned edition, copy information and library location before visiting.
access: This is an academic library. Access and borrowing follow the institution’s membership rules; a catalog listing does not grant borrowing rights.

summary: Find a book and check its ISBN against Alameda County Library’s catalog. The directory includes ten classified library branches, with other service points listed separately.
access: Ask Alameda County Library about membership, borrowing and pickup rules. Use its own catalog for branch-level details.

summary: Check a book’s ISBN against San Mateo County Libraries’ shared catalog. Use the library’s own catalog to confirm the edition, pickup location and borrowing options.
access: Library-card eligibility and borrowing rules are set by San Mateo County Libraries.

summary: Check books at San Francisco Public Library using an ISBN. Open the library’s own catalog for branch details, borrowing options and the latest catalog information.
access: Confirm library-card eligibility, borrowing and pickup rules directly with San Francisco Public Library.

summary: Check an ISBN against Santa Clara County Library’s catalog. Find a book in MyBookshelf, then use the catalog link for detailed branch and borrowing information.
access: Santa Clara County Library sets its own membership and borrowing rules. The county system is separate from Santa Clara City Library.

summary: Check ISBN availability for Setagaya City Library in Tokyo through Calil. Results can identify library locations; some checks take time while Calil consults the catalog.
access: Confirm registration and borrowing rules with Setagaya City Library. Availability is provided through Calil (カーリル), not a direct library affiliation.
